arm_balance.sentence: The arms are independent conversations that share turn~1 verbatim; their turn-1 states agree to within 0.9 points on the answerability distribution (median answer length 46 against 45.0 words), so the turn-2 difference is not inherited from turn~1.

between_d4_d6.label: Between D4 and D6 (the monotonicity step)

between_d4_d5.label: Between D4 and D5 (the state branch)

noise_floor.sentence: Two samples of an unchanged condition disagree on $\Phi$ 22\% of the time, 10\% of it downward: that is the floor. Downward moves at D4$\rightarrow$D6 occur at 11\%, indistinguishable from it, so we withdraw item-level non-monotonicity as a standalone finding and read the trajectory figure only as a noise-inclusive upper bound; the \emph{net} step survives at +5.7 points [+1.6, +9.8]. The branch behaves differently --- D4$\rightarrow$D5 falls at 19\% against 10\% upward, roughly twice the floor, paired gap +5.7 [+1.2, +10.7] --- so it is separable from sampling noise.

controls.sentence: Removing the curator note moves $\Phi$ by at most -2.1 points on the conditions that carry it, so systems were not reading the benchmark's own commentary; and equalising the instructions leaves the D4$\rightarrow$D5 step at -5.4 [-12.5, +1.8] against -6.9 [-13.2, -0.6] on the same cells under the main wording --- a difference of +1.5 [-4.6, +7.6], not separable from zero, so wording does not account for the branch, though 90 items cannot confirm it alone.
